name: COG
source:
At HNI Industries, we believe hard work builds a brighter tomorrow. 

Become part of a team that keeps the cogs of progress turning, one keystroke at a time. 

Your new future starts here.

[From [url=https://deadline-co.itch.io/cog]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在HNI工业集团，我们坚信辛勤耕耘必将铸就更加辉煌的明天。

加入我们的团队，用每一次敲击键盘的努力，让进步的齿轮永不停歇地运转下去。

你的崭新未来，自此启程。
